meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 安装后,当需要迁移旧记忆时,Claude 会暂停相关任务组,把旧版 NanoClaw 和 Claude 的记忆文件移到共享记忆树,整理成统一格式并建立索引,完成后验证和可回滚。
howto.when: 更新后报告共享记忆不兼容,或群组里还有 .seed.md、旧版 CLAUDE.md、Claude 自动记忆等遗留文件时触发;也可以说“migrate memory”等关键词触发。

say.text: 帮我把旧版 CLAUDE.md 迁移到共享记忆树
say.note: 会启动迁移流程,先暂停相关任务再处理。

say.text: 智能体切换后忘了一切,请迁移遗留记忆
say.note: 会检查并迁移 .seed.md 等遗留文件。

say.text: 运行记忆迁移,把 .seed.md 转成新指令文件

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree. It pauses affected task groups, moves and classifies old files, builds indexes, and produces a migration report for approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered after an update reports a shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has legacy files like .seed.md, old CLAUDE.md, or Claude auto-memory. Also responds to phrases like 'migrate memory'.

say_en.text: Migrate my old CLAUDE.md to the shared memory tree.
say_en.note: Starts the migration with task pausing first.

say_en.text: The agent forgot everything after the switch; please migrate legacy memory.
say_en.note: Checks and migrates leftover files like .seed.md.

say_en.text: Run memory migration and convert .seed.md to the new instruction file.
